name: Anchovy rice crackers
summary: Seasoned Sê San anchovy poured onto rice paper and dried, sold as a gift. The 22 July 2022 article says the idea came from doing the same with Biển Hồ shrimp.
origin: Hà Thị Diễm Bé, quoted by the Vietnam National Authority of Tourism, started the cracker after a relative dried seasoned Biển Hồ shrimp on rice paper.
howToEat: Season the fish, pour it over the rice paper, and dry it.
Carry it home. The article names buyers in Pleiku and beyond, including Kon Tum, Huế, and Ho Chi Minh City.
